recommendationsWithLive.title: Publish an approved policy on digital-asset collateral
recommendationsWithLive.detail: Questions about crypto and digital-asset collateral find no approved document, and the agent answers anyway. Publish a policy, or instruct the agent to decline these questions.

recommendationsWithLive.title: Tighten the agent prompt on approval authority
recommendationsWithLive.detail: Reviewers keep correcting answers that overstate how much a role can approve. Require the agent to quote numeric limits verbatim from the source, and to say when approval is needed.
evidence: 30 of 75 FX & Treasury reviews corrected for this reason · 1 today
Conflicting-claim rate 10% (82 claims)

recommendationsWithLive.title: Keep answers to the product the employee asked about
recommendationsWithLive.detail: Answers drift into nearby products — for example retail cards when the question is about SME accounts. Instruct the agent to answer only for the product named in the question.
evidence: 9 of 46 Fees & Charges reviews corrected for this reason
9 answers corrected for answering a different question
